coding.note: The report releases phi-1 and describes phi-1-base and phi-1-small. Claims are restricted to the model introduction and substantive contribution statements in the abstract/introduction; section pointers to evaluation and contamination studies are not treated as explicit novelty claims. No novel ARCH or TRAIN contribution is asserted; the architecture and training are described as conventional. Seeds are not reported: checkpoints, different model sizes, and pruning experiments are not independent-seed counts. Comparator evaluation is MIXED across the report: Table 1 uses self-reported scores, whereas Table 2 reports the authors' new evaluation of competing models. Data disclosure is PARTIAL despite source categories and approximate quantities because synthetic-generation details are explicitly withheld. Comparator names are capped at 15, omitting some redundant size/prompt variants. The dedicated evaluation-problem team is not evidence of independent external model evaluation.

claims.quote:
In this work we go beyond the initial foray of Eldan and Li to show that high quality

  dataset size and training compute.
claims.claim: Use high-quality filtered and synthetic textbook-style data to achieve strong code-model performance with substantially less data and compute.
